Class InitGameState

java.lang.Object
org.adsl.server.controller.states.ControllerState
org.adsl.server.controller.states.InitGameState
All Implemented Interfaces:
RequestVisitor<VirtualClient>
public class InitGameState extends ControllerState
Automatic state that initialises the game board at the start of the first round, executed once per game after all players have picked their totems.

Builds the Board from the loaded configuration, creates the three era building decks, fills both card rows, places players on the order tile in random order before transition to TotemPlacementState.

If the game is already marked as initialised (recovered from persistence) the board setup is skipped and the state transitions immediately.

    • fillLowRow

      public void fillLowRow(int targetSize)
      Draws cards from the deck into the lower row until it reaches targetSize or the deck runs out. Cards that cannot be drawn (e.g. requiring a player presence) are placed in the top row instead and do not count towards targetSize.
      Parameters:
      targetSize - desired number of tribe cards in the lower row

    • fillTopRow

      public void fillTopRow(int targetSize)
      Draws cards from the deck to fill empty slots in the top row up to targetSize, stopping early if the deck runs out.
      Parameters:
      targetSize - desired number of tribe cards in the top row

    • makeBuildingDecks

      public void makeBuildingDecks(Set<Building> buildings, int numPlayers, GameSettings gameSettings)
      Splits the full set of buildings into three per-era decks (shuffled and trimmed to the configured size), places the era-1 deck face up in the top row, and keeps the era-2 and era-3 decks for later refills.
      Parameters:
      buildings - all building cards available for this player count
      numPlayers - number of players in the game
      gameSettings - settings controlling how many buildings per era are used
